name: 3-Day Notice Validator
tagline: Checks California pay-or-quit notices field by field before you serve them
description: Built around California three-day notices to pay rent or quit, with City of Los Angeles residential requirements in mind. Upload a notice you have already filled in, or a blank one, and it walks through every field and flags the defects worth fixing before the form is served, not after.
author: SinaiLawFirm
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
